subject: RDMA: Fix listener priv opaque pointer (#1194)
reason: The change is confined to src/rdma.c, which is compiled only when Valkey is built with BUILD_RDMA=module (default is BUILD_RDMA=no), so the fuzzer's builds do not contain the changed code at all. Even on an RDMA-enabled build, reaching rdmaFdToListener/rdmaChangeListener requires an RDMA device (or root-configured soft-RoCE) and a client speaking the RDMA transport; no installed component, tool or experiment speaks RDMA, and the runs have no root. No scenario can reach the changed behaviour.
